messages:
Maria Chen: Quick follow-up on streaming retries: proposal to add a session binding header so short reconnects can reuse KV/prefix caches. Suggest `x-stream-session: <uuid>` + optional resume trailer.

Devon K: sounds useful. question: how do we avoid sticking requests that have side effects?

Maria Chen: route-level opt-in only. gateway will reject session headers for routes marked non-resumable.

Suraj P: ops: need TTL + lease refresh. also an explicit invalidation signal when a backend restarts. can't allow infinite sticky bindings.

Adam L: fallback behavior: if binding lost, route to a fast stateless replica and return a progress hint rather than forcing a full restart. better UX.

Lina R: observability: emit per-session traces and periodic `x-progress` trailers so Console can show live progress and cost attribution. SDKs should expose resume APIs.

OpsBot: perf note: simulate 10k synthetic sticky sessions (`sticky-sim`) prior to rollout.

Maria Chen: routing options: consistent-hash(session-id) || ephemeral map+lease || hybrid (CH initial, map overrides). David H can run perf sims.

Devon K: security: resume tokens must be opaque, tenant-bound, and TTL-limited. no raw model state in tokens.

Maria Chen: admin API: `POST /admin/sessions/{id}/invalidate` for ops-only forced detach with audit log.

Suraj P: I'll own runbook + chaos tests.

Lina R: I'll draft observability + SDK examples.

Maria Chen: I'll write the RFC this week (header schema, lifecycle, routing, fallback, observability, security, admin APIs). Volunteers to review?

Devon K: I'll review.

OpsBot: task created: `sticky-sim-v1` in perf infra.
